stepIdRule: Every node ID is globally unique and namespaced by game, map, quest, and node. Shared guidance is not duplicated: a node may be referenced by multiple paths.

implementationNotes: The stock quest script initializes six handlers concurrently. The source header documents their intended order, but the handlers do not all enforce a strict prior-flag dependency; treat each flag as that node's success state, and confirm physical access requirements separately.

nodes.title: Hold the pressure plate
nodes.instruction: Have every player stay inside the pressure area by the rocket pad for two minutes. Leaving the area resets the timer.

nodes.title: Solve Pure Harmony
nodes.instruction: Ensemble Cast co-op step only (Stand-in/solo skips it). The target reads 2-7-4-6 from top to bottom: Yellow 2, Orange 7, Blue 4, Purple 6. Because turning one dial moves others, follow this sequence exactly: 1) Purple until Purple reads 6. 2) Orange until Blue reads 4. 3) Yellow until Orange reads 7. 4) Turn Yellow until it reads 2, counting every click. 5) Turn Purple the same number of clicks counted in step 4. 6) Turn Blue until it reads 4. Verify the final top-to-bottom reading is 2-7-4-6.

items.label: Set Purple to 6
items.location: Bottom level of the lighthouse dial stack.

items.label: Turn Orange until Blue reads 4
items.location: Orange dial, second level from the top.

items.label: Turn Yellow until Orange reads 7
items.location: Top-level Yellow dial.

items.label: Turn Yellow to 2 and count the clicks
items.location: Top-level Yellow dial; record the number of clicks for the next action.

items.label: Turn Purple by the same click count
items.location: Bottom-level Purple dial; match the exact number of Yellow clicks from step 4.

items.label: Turn Blue until it reads 4; verify 2-7-4-6
items.location: Blue dial, third level from the top; read all four dials from top to bottom.

nodes.instruction: Use the V-R11 on a zombie at the lighthouse base so it rises in the green beam. Shoot the transformed human with explosive damage until it goes limp before reaching the top. Take the Golden Rod from the lighthouse base, return it to the transfer tube by the Ultimis door, then knife the sparking fusebox.

nodes.title: Set the mud-room dials
nodes.instruction: Before the dial room, knife all 12 wall panels and destroy the outside snare/teepee with an explosive, then activate the mine-cart radio. In the mud room, set the four dials to 4, 3, 16, 1 according to the wall-order instruction. Do not invent a fixed order for the randomized tile pairs or gongs.
